column4: Custom questions now show an unknown rate when both totals are incomplete, and label individual positive or negative bounds correctly.
Large custom-question rates no longer shrink when their two-decimal display exceeds the integer rounding range.
Added exact, incomplete, negative, zero and large-rate cases, plus native Android answer-window checks.
Recorded the preceding verified APK and the reproduced rate-display failures and successful targeted checks.
I corrected misleading rate answers when recordings are incomplete. Large rates also retain their represented value instead of being clipped by display rounding.
